review: 4:1 עֵת הֶחָטָף — 'the snatching moment' (1 Thess 4:17, נֶחְטַף); the Arabic وَقْتُ اخْتِطَافٍ is the rapture, and חָטַף is the biblical verb for snatching away used already in hymn 44.
4:2 נִפְגַּשׁ בָּאֲוִיר — 1 Thessalonians 4:17 (בָּעָבִים … בָּאֲוִיר); the Arabic نَلْقَى فِي الْهَوَا is that verse, and אֲוִיר is kept for the air.
5:6 כָּמוֹךָ נִרְאֶךָ — 1 John 3:2 (כַּאֲשֶׁר הוּא נִרְאֶה); the Arabic وَكَمَا أَنْتَ نَرَاك says 'as You are, we see You', and Hebrew keeps the comparison although the subject is reversed.
3:6 לֹא תָבִישׁ הַמְיַחֲלִים — 'it shall not put its hopers to shame' (Rom 5:5, לֹא תְבִישֵׁנוּ); the Arabic لَيْسَ يُخْزِي الْمُرْتَجِين is the same promise.
